policy.token_source: Exact observed logout request headers or query fields, retained only in memory
policy.token_fingerprint: SHA-256 of the decoded observed token
policy.browser_context_requirement: Fresh context, no storageState, attached before first page
policy.metadata_policy: Only observed authorization and allowlisted Emby client metadata are replayed
